Wärtsilä in brief

Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions
for the marine and energy markets. We emphasise innovation in sustainable
technology and services to help our customers continuously improve environmental
and economic performance. Our dedicated and passionate team of 17,900
professionals in 199 locations in 78 countries shape the decarbonisation
transformation of our industries across the globe. In 2025, Wärtsilä's net sales
totalled EUR 6.2 billion. Wärtsilä is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.
www.wartsila.com
